pages.text: $(thing)Jellies$() are friendly blobs of slime that appear on various planets and environments. $(br2)They have a variety of uses, but most commonly, they produce type-specific $(thing)slime balls$(). $(br2)Did I mention they are very friendly? If you raise their familiarity high enough, they will become pets and happily follow you around!
$(thing)Jellies$() are hermaphroditic and can reproduce with any other $(thing)jellie$()!

pages.title: Produce
pages.text: $(thing)Jellies$() are quite picky and will refuse to produce anything outside of their natural habitat; however, they will breed just fine in any environment. $(br2)They also dislike machines and will only give their produce when fed manually by a player.$(br2)$(#B0B0B0)$(o)Or maybe they just want attention...
$(thing)Nutritional Mash$() is the main food of all $(thing)jellies$(), primarily made from grains, fruits, and some dimension-specific ingredients. $(br2)$(#B0B0B0)$(o)Why is it moving...

pages.name: Herbal Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Herbal$() jellies spawn on Earth in warm forests, with $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() between 1-10°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 150mm. They produce $(thing)Herbal Slime Balls$().

pages.name: Phosphorum Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Phosphorum$() jellies spawn on Earth in cold forests, with $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)temperature$() between -10-0°C and $(l:the_world/climate#rainfall)rainfall$() of at least 150mm. They produce $(thing)Phosphorum Slime Balls$() and additionally eat $(thing)rotten flesh$().

pages.name: Rock Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Rock$() jellies rarely spawn on Earth in caves of mountainous biomes. Currently, they do nothing.

pages.name: Spring Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Spring$() jellies spawn in Beneath's geothermal spring biome. They produce $(thing)Spring Slime Balls$().

pages.name: Plant Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Plant$() jellies spawn in Beneath's muggy bog and thorny brambles biomes. They produce $(thing)Plant Slime Balls$().

pages.name: Glowberry Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Glowberry$() jellies spawn in Beneath's lush hollow biome. They produce $(thing)Glowberry Slime Balls$().

pages.name: Biotite Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Biotite$() jellies spawn at the bottom of the Beneath. They produce $(thing)Biotite Slime Balls$().

pages.name: Ice Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Ice$() jellies spawn in Beneath's salt caves. They passively reduce player's temperature by 10°C.

pages.name: Lava Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Lava$() jellies spawn at the bottom of the Beneath. They passively increase player's temperature by 10°C.

pages.name: Latex Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Latex$() jellies are made by breeding $(thing)Lava$() and $(thing)Plant$() jellies. They produce $(thing)Latex Slime Balls$().

pages.name: Certus Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Certus$() jellies spawn in Moon's asurine biomes. They produce $(thing)Large Certus Quartz Buds$().

pages.name: Pentetic Jellie
pages.text: $(thing)Pentetic$() jellies spawn in Mars' martian deep desert and martian mountain biomes. They passively absorbs radiation from players.
